baseline: 保留已成功 Extractor/OCR/Layout/四點原文流程，外接工作台、稽核及增量層
canonical_database: Parquet only; ZSTD; atomically switched versioned catalog; DuckDB reads/merges/spills to TEMP

exports.CSV: explicit UTF-8 BOM view copy, formula-safe text
exports.Google Sheets: CSV import available; direct cloud write blocked until locked transport adapter is verified

input.drag_drop: File API chunks → native WebView2 JS API; no HTTP listener
input.duplicates: format+size first; filename second; report identity third; SHA256 exact verification
input.delete: managed import copies -> recoverable recycle; originals untouched
input.scope: All supported report files recursively; no ticker/broker/file-count/size filter

incremental.identity: Original source SHA256; normalized PDF hash separately recorded
incremental.partial_grain: missing report file only; existing extractor caches retained; per-field targeted read not claimed
incremental.policy_change: AUDIT_ONLY; UI/policy/finance contract changes do not repeat raw extraction
incremental.successful_summary: preserve existing four points on OCR repairs; re-audit before marking verified

validation: official historical actual over forecast with original retained
multiplication with independent diluted numerator basis
adjusted price/target and report anchor dates
ROE average equity; PER diluted EPS
source quotations; missing provenance remains unverified

coverage.AST_instrumentation: all defs in external VDF source, runtime trace, hash verified before in-memory decoration
coverage.real_Celeritas: UNVERIFIED until verified real API and per-verb runtime evidence
coverage.locked_network: mandatory for every external data fetch; no standalone fallback

limits: PC prior chain and v1652 not available in sandbox
Parquet has no spreadsheet row cap but resource limits remain
company deadlines and dividends need official evidence; never auto-fill verified=true
Gate commands require explicit local registration
converted inputs require visual review; conversion alone cannot certify finance or quotations
Windows WebView2/PS7 and full private manager chain require PC acceptance
DOCX uses installed renderer when available; otherwise text/table/embedded-image projection stays unverified. Binary DOC needs installed Word/LibreOffice.
All-page ContentData supplements the original selected-page financial extractor; raw OCR does not certify arithmetic or a four-point quotation.
acceptance: No complete/active label when financial or transport proof is missing
